title: 第20章
content:
“愿意！”陈青云满脸兴奋，激动无比。这可是天赐良机！30岁的县长，全省都十分少见。跟着宁轻眉，甚至比跟着之前的唐县长更有前途。“不过宁县长，我们毕竟男女有别，如果我当你的秘书，恐怕会引来非议吧？”陈青云忍不住问道。“清者自清，浊者自浊，不用去管那些流言蜚语！而且我初来松山县，其他人都不熟悉，只信得过你！”宁轻眉说道。“宁县长，我不会辜负您的信任。”陈青云十分激动，同时心中暗道：难怪之前萧云妃和他打赌，说他要交贵人，原来早就知道这一切了。接下来，陈青云又将松山县官场上的格局，给宁轻眉梳理了一遍。尤其是县委书记赵天雄，仗着自己资历老，行事霸道，搞一言堂，就连前任县长唐志华的身亡，和他也脱不了关系。听完后，宁轻眉眉头紧皱，没想到小小的松山县，山头林立，竟然这么复杂。但她也更加觉得自己用对人了，开口道：“陈秘书，你回去准备一下，待会我就让人下任命通知！”……当天下午。一则人事命令，震惊了整个县政府办。陈青云担任新县长的秘书，同时，提拔为政府办副主任。一时间，四方轰动，热议无数。“天哪！陈青云是走了什么狗屎运，竟然被宁县长看上了？”“他虽然还是副科，但职务变成政府办的副主任，这可是高升了啊！”“没错！就连戴斌这个科长，都要归他管了！”陈青云瞬间成为红人，无数科室都在谈论着他的名字，不少人都想着套近乎巴结。几家欢喜几家愁！这边陈青云春风得意，那边戴斌却愁容满面，比吃了苍蝇还难受。昨天陈青云官复原职，已经打了他的脸。没想到今天，竟然摇身一变，爬到他的头上去。他今后在秘书科的日子，恐怕不好过了！这一整天，戴斌都过得魂不守舍，下班后一个人喝了闷酒，醉醺醺的回到家。他看到妻子苏瑶，正穿着性感的瑜伽服，在垫子上弯腰撅臀，摆出一个诱人的姿势。

她今年27岁，是县招商局出了名的一枝花，惦记她的人不知有多少。当初戴斌还是县长秘书，百般跪舔，才抱得美人归。不过这些年，戴斌仕途不顺，苏瑶对他的态度也越来越冷淡。“你怎么又喝酒了？不是答应过我戒酒了么？”苏瑶看到他满身酒气，一脸嫌弃。“哎……陈青云竟然当上新县长的秘书，还提拔成了我的上司，我只能借酒消愁啊！”戴斌叹了一口气。“什么，那小子升官了？”苏瑶十分惊讶，美眸中闪过一抹异色。当初，她妹妹苏妍儿和陈青云谈恋爱，她也见过陈青云几次，对那个高大帅气的年轻很有好感。不过，妹妹却嫌弃陈青云穷，果断分手，又找了个市里的官宦子弟。“是啊，那个臭小子，简直走了狗屎运！”接下来，戴斌将白天的遭遇说了一遍，又拉住苏瑶的玉手，央求道：“老婆，现在只有你能帮我了！”“什么意思？”苏瑶皱了皱眉。“老婆，你能不能去勾引陈青云，把他给迷住！只要拿到他的把柄，咱们就不用怕了！”戴斌厚着脸皮说道。“啪！”苏瑶又羞又怒，抽了戴斌一耳光，破口大骂：“戴斌，你还是不是男人，竟然要把自己老婆献出去，你想当绿毛龟，我还嫌丢脸呢？”戴斌捂着脸，继续劝说：“老婆，我不都是为了这个家么？一旦陈青云那小子上位，不光会报复我，更会报复你和你妹，当初你妹甩了他，这笔账可还没算呢！”“而且，我又不是让你陪他睡觉，就是灌醉他，然后拍几张不雅照！”“放心，事成之后，我会好好补偿你的！”苏瑶也没办法，最终无奈点头：“行，那我就答应你，不过我看上一款包包，你得买给我！”“好好好，只要搞定这件事，什么条件我都答应你！”戴斌立刻拍胸脯保证。“不过，我长得没我妹好看，陈青云能看上我么？不行，我得换件衣服，好好打扮一下！”苏瑶起身，准备去梳妆打扮。“老婆，不用！你身上的韵味，可不是小女孩能比的，就穿着紧身瑜伽服，前凸后翘，再把胸口拉低一点，只要是个男人都会被你迷住！”戴斌夸奖道。“行，那你快点约他吧！”苏瑶点头，脑海中浮现出陈青云那高大帅气的身影，心中非但不讨厌，竟然有些期待起来。很快，戴斌拨通了陈青云的电话，开门见山：“陈秘书……啊不，陈主任，之前我们有点误会，我想请您吃饭赔罪！”

"Yes!" Chen Qingyun's face was filled with excitement and excitement.This is a God-given opportunity!A 30-year-old county magistrate is very rare in the province.Following Ning Qingmei is even more promising than following County Magistrate Tang before."But County Magistrate Ning, after all, we are different between men and women. If I become your secretary, I'm afraid it will attract criticism, right?" Chen Qingyun couldn't help but ask."The pure will be pure by themselves, and the turbid will be turbid by themselves. Don't worry about the rumors! Besides, I am new to Songshan County and no one else is familiar with it. I can only trust you!" Ning Qingmei said."County Magistrate Ning, I will not let down your trust." Chen Qingyun was very excited, and at the same time thought to himself: No wonder Concubine Xiao Yun made a bet with him before, saying that he would make friends with noble people. It turns out that she already knew all this.Next, Chen Qingyun sorted out the layout of Songshan County's officialdom for Ning Qingmei.In particular, Zhao Tianxiong, secretary of the county party committee, relied on his seniority to act domineeringly and make a statement. Even the death of the former county magistrate Tang Zhihua was inseparable from him.After hearing this, Ning Qing frowned. She didn't expect that the small Songshan County, with its numerous hills, would be so complicated.But she also felt that she had hired the right person, so she said, "Secretary Chen, go back and prepare. I will send someone to notify you of the appointment later!"... That afternoon.A personnel order shocked the entire county government office.Chen Qingyun served as the secretary of the new county magistrate and was promoted to deputy director of the government office.For a time, there was a sensation in all directions and numerous heated discussions."Oh my God! What kind of bad luck did Chen Qingyun have to be favored by County Magistrate Ning?" "Although he is still a deputy department, his position has become the deputy director of the government office. This is a high promotion!" "That's right! Even Dai Bin, the section chief, will be under his control!" Chen Qingyun instantly became a celebrity. Countless departments were talking about his name, and many people were trying to flatter him.Some are happy and some are sad!Here Chen Qingyun is proud of the spring breeze, but over there Dai Bin has a sad face, which is worse than eating a fly.Official Chen Qingyun was reinstated yesterday, which slapped him in the face.Unexpectedly, today, he suddenly transformed and climbed onto his head.I'm afraid his life in the secretarial department will not be easy in the future!Dai Bin spent the whole day in a state of confusion. After get off work, he drank alone and came home drunk.He saw his wife Su Yao, wearing sexy yoga clothes, bending over the mat and sticking her butt out, striking a seductive pose.

She is 27 years old and is a well-known beauty in the county investment promotion bureau. There are countless people who miss her.Back then, Dai Bin was still the county magistrate's secretary, and he knelt down and licked her in every possible way to win the beauty back.However, in recent years, Dai Bin's official career has not been smooth, and Su Yao's attitude towards him has become increasingly cold."Why are you drinking again? Didn't you promise me to quit drinking?" Su Yao looked disgusted when she saw that he smelled of alcohol."Hey... Chen Qingyun actually became the secretary of the new county magistrate and was promoted to my boss. I can only drink to relieve my sorrow!" Dai Bin sighed."What, that boy got promoted?" Su Yao was very surprised, and a strange color flashed in her beautiful eyes.At the beginning, her sister Su Yaner was in love with Chen Qingyun. She also met Chen Qingyun several times and had a good impression of the tall and handsome young man.However, her younger sister disliked Chen Qingyun for being poor, so she decisively broke up with him and found another son of a city official."Yeah, that brat is so lucky!" Next, Dai Bin told what happened during the day, took Su Yao's hand again, and begged: "Honey, you are the only one who can help me now!" "What do you mean?" Su Yao frowned."Honey, can you seduce Chen Qingyun and charm him! As long as we get his handle, we don't have to be afraid!" Dai Bin said shamelessly."Pa!" Su Yao was ashamed and angry. She slapped Dai Bin and yelled: "Dai Bin, you are still not a man. You want to give your wife away. You want to be a green turtle. Why am I embarrassed?" Dai BinBin covered his face and continued to persuade: "Honey, aren't I doing this for this family? Once that boy Chen Qingyun comes to power, he will not only take revenge on me, but also on you and your sister. When your sister dumped him, the debt can be repaid.Don't worry!" "Besides, I'll either let you sleep with him or get him drunk and take some indecent photos!" "Don't worry, I will make it up to you!" Su Yao had no choice but to nod in the end: "Okay, I will agree to it, but you have to buy it for me!" "Okay, as long as this is done, I will agree to whatever you want!""However, I'm not as good-looking as my sister. Can Chen Qingyun like me? No, I have to change my clothes and dress up!" Su Yao got up and prepared to dress up."Honey, no need! The charm of your body is not comparable to that of a little girl. Just wear tight yoga clothes, bulge your front and back, and pull your chest down a little. Any man will be fascinated by you!" Dai Bin praised."Okay, then hurry up and make an appointment with him!" Su Yao nodded, thinking of Chen Qingyun's tall and handsome figure. Instead of hating him, she was actually looking forward to it.Soon, Dai Bin dialed Chen Qingyun's phone number and got straight to the point: "Secretary Chen... ah no, Director Chen, we had a misunderstanding before. I want to treat you to a meal to apologize!"
